text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's the day of the Fukuryu
Stakes—the open
dirt race we chose to
enter in place of the Satsuki
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Say, Trainer. I know we decided I
wouldn't enter
the Satsuki Sho, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What do you think of the Japanese
Derby for our
next race? You'd like me
to enter it, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Derby isn't a race that just anyone
can freely enter. And, aptitude aside,
Copano Rickey is
capable of meeting
the requirements.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Because it's a special race.
Yeah. It's a special race, after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If the timing works out right,
I would like
to
consider it, at the very least.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Got it! I'll race with that in mind!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(The qi is really... faint.
Both that of the
racers
and the spectators...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, that figures. Obviously, the
intensity is much
lower than the Satsuki
Sho.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(The calm makes the situation difficult
to read. Even so, there's got to be
something here to help
me decide
whether dirt or turf is the way to go.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Silence. Yes, this silence is also the
dragon's
voice. The dragon within the
earth is trying to
relay something to me!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even if I don't stand out now, if I keep
doing my
best, someday people will
notice and I can be
famous!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Turf really is the shining star of the
racing world,
and I was stuck on that for
ages.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh?! I see. Could that be what it's all about?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If my guess is right, the path I should
take is...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No... I'm still not sure. But,
if I can prove
myself in
this race...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The dragon will surely reveal its face and
point
me in the direction of good
fortune. All righty!
